subject: social_studies
concept: Understanding that different families and communities have different traditions and ways of doing things
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a tradition or custom to the kind of occasion it's connected to
exercise.abstract: Student describes one tradition from their own family or community, and shows curiosity about someone else's

assessment.success_marker: student engages respectfully and curiously with the idea that traditions differ across families and communities
